summary: Make every module catalog group start collapsed and render the plastic trash-bin body mesh white while preserving the corrected trash-bin geometry.

impactAnalysis.notes: UI/render follow-up only. The Item contract was reviewed because trash-bin is a physical Item. State, placement, behavior and performance are marked affected because scene3d is a high-risk runtime surface required by the gate; their semantics are reviewed but intentionally unchanged. All catalog groups initialize collapsed. The actual Waste Basket body mesh is Object_5; its dark base-color texture is removed and the base color is forced to white. Sphere_1 continues to be pruned before bounds fitting.

e2e.reason: Chromium verifies every catalog group is initially collapsed, real trash drag/drop completes, Sphere_1 is pruned, and the actual Object_5 body material is white with no dark base-color map.

risk.notes: Primary risks are catalog accordion default-state regression or applying the white override to the wrong GLB mesh. The source GLB was inspected: Object_5 is the 956-vertex Waste Basket body branch, while Sphere_1 is the unrelated backdrop sphere.

migration.notes: No persisted schema or runtime Item identity changes.

rollback: Revert the catalog default-closed change and trash body material override if the UI or trash appearance regresses.
